limitations: No scanner proves absence of unknown/custom/encrypted secrets.
No account files outside repository or private player directories were accessed.
No credentials were submitted to any service.
No dynamic hook/script/credential verification or cloud scanner upload.
Patterns and candidate classification require human review; fixtures are not automatically exonerated.
Binary ASCII and PE UTF-16 strings do not decompile or decode every packed payload.

coverage.snapshotSemantics: Each complete working-tree file read is individually SHA256 bound. HEAD is the baseline commit, not a claim of a globally atomic or clean working-tree snapshot.

coverage.scope: All unique blobs reachable from every local Git ref; no dangling objects, reflog-only unreachable objects or un-fetched remote refs.
